summary: Customer reports duplicate charge; agent initiates chargeback.

intents.keywords: Hey, I've been charged...twice on my statement.
actions of agent: Identified the issue as a duplicate charge.
Offered to initiate a chargeback request.
Provided timeframe for refund (5-7 business days).
intents.resolution: Chargeback request initiated; refund expected in 5-7 business days.
intents.agent professionalism: Agent remained calm and professional despite customer's frustration.
